subject: Update redis to valkey in generate-commands-json.py (#238)
reason: The change edits only utils/generate-commands-json.py, a developer helper script: it renames 'redis-cli' to 'valkey-cli' in the argparse description string and in the default value of the --cli argument. No server code, command implementation, tool (valkey-cli/benchmark/check-rdb/check-aof), replication, cluster, or persistence path is affected, so no server reply or behaviour can differ between the builds and no fuzzer scenario can exercise it.
